Left keratometry axis flat curve (deg) – continuous measurement of the flat meridian axis of the cornea.
Left keratometry radius steep curve (mm) – continuous measurement of the radius of curvature for the steep meridian.
Left keratometry power steep curve (D) – continuous measurement of the refractive power of the steep meridian.
Left keratometry axis steep curve (deg) – continuous measurement of the steep meridian axis.
Left keratometry radius, average (mm) – continuous measurement of the average corneal radius.
Left keratometry power, average (D) – continuous measurement of the average corneal refractive power.
Left keratometry cylinder – continuous measurement of the corneal cylinder (difference between steep and flat meridian powers).
Left keratometry axis (deg) – continuous measurement of the overall corneal axis.
Right visual acuity, presenting – ordinal measurement of visual acuity with current correction.
Left visual acuity, presenting – ordinal measurement of visual acuity with current correction.
Right visual acuity, w/ objective refraction – ordinal measurement of visual acuity after objective refraction.
Left visual acuity, w/ objective refraction – ordinal measurement of visual acuity after objective refraction.
